summary: Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) re-quoting a 3438 SELL / 687 BUY pair every ~3s at the touch. Cancels and re-quotes happen together on both sides and follow the moving touch as the market drifted down. Its SELL quotes were executed (9229 filled). There was no opposite-side (BUY) execution, so no benefit. No single order reached 3x depth (max 1.43x). No news or risk events. The trigger came from the naive detector reading the quote refresh as a cancel burst. Closing as market making.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting both sides at its typical 2996 size, re-quoting every 2-3s. The one large order, BUY O-00017597 (28280, 11.75x depth, at the touch), was genuinely executing. 15016 (53%) executed before the trader's only opposite-side trade on it (SELL 499 at 12:39:14.737). The price did not move (0.0) and did not revert. The remainder was cancelled 2.4s after that small sell. Feature (a) is absent for the large order and feature (b) is absent. Window-level numbers are driven by the two-sided quote refresh, which is ordinary MM activity.

Registered MM on SYN.A quoted two-sided at desk-typical size (2880) for about 80s; that quoting looks like ordinary market making. The window ends with a separate order that does not fit: a one-sided BUY of 24122 (10.0x depth) placed 3 ticks from the touch with nothing resting on the other side. 1.8s later the trader sold 1200 by market order. The BUY was cancelled 422ms after that sale, with no fills on it. Market making does not account for this order, so both core features are present on its own record. Escalate to Level 2. Not DRAFT_STOR: one cycle only and no prior alerts.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at its typical size (2467, about 1.0x depth), re-quoting every 2-3 s with paired cancels. Cancels are symmetric (0.979), no single order reaches 3x depth, and the quotes sit at or inside the touch. Fills were on its own resting quotes. There is no one-sided order and no benefit beyond ordinary spread (round trip 0.11 ticks). The detector fired on gross submitted size from the constant re-quoting. Closure standard met.

Registered MM on SYN.A quoted two-sided at 2485 (typical size) with ~40 quote refreshes that fit market making. The detector's trigger rests on those quotes. But at 10:58:19.353 the trader placed a single one-sided SELL of 18864 (7.83x depth, 2 ticks from touch, nothing resting on the buy side), 7.6x his typical size. It had no executions. 1.8s later a 1035 BUY market order was executed, and the SELL was cancelled 140ms after that. The quote explanation does not account for this order. Feature (a) is not excluded. Feature (b) is ambiguous, because the buy swept up to the trader's own 9999 level, which the procedure says is not a hidden benefit. With the evidence mixed and no explanation supported for the large order, I propose escalation to Level 2. I do not propose a STOR draft: there is one cycle, and the benefit is not clear.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) re-quoting a SELL 3124 / BUY 624 pair about every 3 s, both sides cancelled and refreshed together. Largest order is 1.30x depth, so no single order reaches 3x depth. SELL quotes were executing (11050 filled, 3272 before the only opposite-side buy of 624). The buy filled at 9995 and the touch then fell to 9990, so the trader got no favourable move. Round trip is -1.43 ticks and reversion is 0. Both core features are absent and market making is supported.

Registered SYN.A market maker quoting both sides at its typical size of 2138 (about 0.89x depth). Quotes are re-priced together every 2-3s. Its BUY quotes were actually executed. Opposite-side fills were small, and the price did not move in its favour. No large single order, no repetition, no event. The detector fired on gross size and cancel volume, which are normal for quoting.

Detector fired on a registered market maker's repeated two-sided 3164-lot quotes (its typical size) with fills on one side and a quick cancel of the other. These are ordinary quote cycles. The one order of at least 3x depth is SELL O-00034926 (31515, 13.1x depth, at the touch). It was executing: 14691 (46.6%) filled before the trader's only opposite-side trade, a BUY of 527. The remainder was cancelled after that. The standard treats this as a working order with feature (a) absent, and the smaller opposite trade as ordinary order management, not feature (b). No public event, no prior alerts. Evidence is a little mixed: the large order's own price move is +1.0 with 0.5 reversion. I rely on the order-of-events test, so I propose closure with moderate confidence.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM desk) re-quoting a bid and an offer about every 3 seconds at its typical size of 3,630, which is 1.44x depth. No single order reached 3x depth. The SELL quotes were repeatedly executed (10,674 filled, 3,071 of it before the only opposite-side fill of 346), so the resting orders were working. The one BUY execution came with a 2-tick price move but 0 reversion after the cancels. Feature (a) and feature (b) are both absent. Residual caveats: the SELL quote is 5x the BUY quote and cancel symmetry is only 0.36.

Registered SYN.A market maker quoting two-sided at its typical size 2979 (cancel_symmetry 0.93) plus one large SELL O-00012960 (21775, 8.7x depth) placed at the touch. That order was working: 9921 (45.6%) executed before the trader's only opposite-side trade (BUY 496), far more than the 496 bought. The BUY came at no favourable move (0.0) and no reversion. Feature (a) is absent and feature (b) is absent. Genuine execution of a working order is supported.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting both sides at its typical size 2991, re-quoting about every 2s. Cancels are symmetric (0.995). No single order reached 3x depth (max 1.19x). Opposite-side fills of 182, 1450 and 60 came with no favourable price move (-1.0 tick) and no reversion (0.0). Round trip is +0.54 tick, which is ordinary spread income. Neither core feature is present and market making is supported.

Registered market maker on SYN.A (ETF-MM) quoting two-sided at its typical 3550 size explains the detector's three triggers. The window also holds one order that quoting does not explain. After about 34 symmetric quote orders, the trader stopped quoting and placed a one-sided BUY of 29036 (11.6x depth) at 10000, 3 ticks from the touch, with nothing resting on the other side. 1.6s later it sold 1479 at market (10003). It cancelled the whole BUY 328ms after that. The large order had no fills. Price moved 0.0 ticks with 0.0 reversion, so I found no clear benefit (feature b). The order has no supported legitimate purpose, so feature (a) is not excluded. The closure standard needs both features absent plus a supported explanation, so I propose ESCALATE to Level 2 and not CLOSE_FP. The evidence is mixed, and it is a single occurrence, so I do not propose DRAFT_STOR.

Detector fired on the trader's two-sided 4075-lot quote churn and on one 36,919 SELL (O-00010383, 12.75x depth). Quotes are typical-size, symmetric (cancel_symmetry 0.87) and from a registered MM. The large SELL was working: 14,332 (38.8%) executed before the trader's only opposite-side trade (BUY 671). That is genuine execution, so feature (a) is absent. The BUY 671 is a small trade, with no reversion (0.0 ticks), so feature (b) is absent. Proposed CLOSE_FP.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoted two-sided at about 3552 for ~80s, which is ordinary. It then placed a one-sided BUY of 28952 (10.0x depth, 3 ticks from the touch) at 11:52:02.343. About 1.7s later it sold 1065 by market order at 10000 down to 9995, when the bid had risen 9998→10000. The BUY was fully cancelled 381ms after that sell. The price then reverted 1.5 ticks. The large order had no executions and no other-side quote resting. Market making accounts for the quotes but not for this order, so both core features look present. Only one cycle was seen, so I propose escalation to Level 2, not a STOR draft.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting both sides at its typical size 4452, refreshing bid and ask together about every 2 s. Cancels are symmetric (0.976) and follow the touch. No single order reached 3x depth. Own-quote fills came first, with no favourable price move and no reversion. Round trip is about 0.09 tick, which is ordinary spread income. Neither core feature is present.

Registered market maker on SYN.A (ETF-MM) re-quoting a 756 BUY and a 3784 SELL together every ~3s, cancelling and re-quoting both at the same instant. No single order reaches 3x depth. The 3784 sell is the desk's typical size and executed in part (7324 total) before any opposite-side trade. The trader made no BUY execution. The touch drifted down, so there was no favourable move or reversion. Neither core feature is present and market making is supported.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at its typical size (2842) and refreshing every ~2s. Cancels are symmetric (0.994) and follow the touch. No single order reached 3x depth. Price did not move in the trader's favour, and there was no reversion. The detector fired on gross quote turnover, not on one-sided spoofing.

Registered SYN.A market maker quoted 2848 on both sides, re-quoting every 2-3 s (typical size). The only single large order is BUY O-00018812 (28290, 11.1x depth, 1 tick below touch). It executed 13632 (48%) before the trader's only opposite trade (SELL 474 at 12:49:08.469), so it was working and not a non-executing display. The 474 sell was small relative to the fills and is ordinary order management. Remainder 14658 was cancelled 3.3 s after that sell. No event, no repetition of the large-order cycle. Caveat: price moved +1 tick with 1 tick reversion on the large order, which I treat as not feature (b) under 6.2, but a reviewer may weigh it.

Registered MM (SYN.A) quoting two-sided at 2917 explains the detector triggers (the 14:07:06-09 cancels of ~2.9k quotes). But the window also holds one SELL LIMIT of 29128 at 10004 (11.4x depth, 2 ticks from touch, nothing resting on the other side) placed 14:07:37.398. It had no fills, and the trader sent a BUY MARKET order 1215 at 14:07:39.877 (1007 filled, sweeping 10002-10004). The big order was cancelled 125 ms later. It is 10x the desk's typical size and not a quote, so the MM explanation does not account for it. Feature (a) looks present. Feature (b) is not shown: price move 0 and reversion 0 on this order, and the market buy paid up through the book. Evidence is mixed, so it goes to Level 2. It is not a STOR draft: the cycle occurred once and no benefit is shown.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) re-quoting a SELL of 4311 and a BUY of 862 every ~3s, following the touch down from 10001 to 9994. The SELL quotes were executing (19282 filled). The trader had no BUY execution, so there was no opposite-side trade and no benefit. The detector read fills on the trader's own SELL quotes as 'SELL executions' against BUY submissions. Core features (a) and (b) are both absent.

Registered MM on SYN.A quoted both sides at its typical 2480 size for about 100s (market-making pattern, a likely cause of the detector trigger). At 10:16:59.868 it then placed a single one-sided SELL of 22965 (9.7x depth) 3 ticks from the touch, with nothing resting on the bid. About 2.7s later it bought 1033 by market order, and it cancelled the SELL 293ms after that buy. The SELL had no executions. Market making does not account for this order (nearly 10x typical size, one-sided, away from the touch). Both core features are plausibly present and no explanation is supported. Only one cycle, with a small favourable move, so I stop short of DRAFT_STOR. Level 2 to review.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) re-quoting a SELL 3669 / BUY 733 pair every ~3s, both legs cancelled and re-priced together as the touch drifted down from 10003 to ~9996. No order reaches 3x depth (max 1.55x). The SELL quotes were executing (8846 filled, 6873 of it before the only opposite-side fills of 298), so they were working orders, not displayed-only size. Opposite fills were small, the price move ended with no reversion, and there is no public event or risk event. Closure standard met: explanation supported, feature (a) absent and feature (b) absent. Caveat: cancel_symmetry 0.35 and a 5:1 size skew between sides, which I read as a desk quoting convention. L2 may want to confirm.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at its typical size (3253) and re-pricing with the touch. Cancels are symmetric (0.994), no order reached 3x depth (max 1.37x), the price moved against the trader (-1.5 ticks) with no reversion, and the round trip is negative (-1.15 ticks). Neither core feature (unintended resting order, opposite-side benefit) is present. The detector fired on gross quote churn.

Registered SYN.A market maker quoting 2540 a side. The detector fired on the quote refresh cycle and on one large SELL, O-00034349 (21695, 9.2x depth). That order was working: 10191 (47%) executed on it BEFORE the trader's only material opposite-side buy (423). The remainder was cancelled 3.1s after that buy. Price moved +1.0 tick with 0.0 reversion. Feature (a) is absent and so is feature (b). Closure standard met on the genuine-execution explanation.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at its typical size of 2640, re-quoting every 1-3s. Cancels are symmetric across sides. No single order reached 3x depth. Price did not move in its favour and there was no reversion. Neither core feature is present. Proposing CLOSE_FP as market making.

T-X0922-02 is a registered SYN.A market maker. For about 80s it quoted both sides at 2812 (its typical size), and that pattern fits market making. At 13:09:38.633 it then placed a one-sided BUY of 25201 (11.07x depth) at 9998, 2 ticks from the touch. It had nothing resting on the other side. The order had no executions. About 2.1s later the trader sent a MARKET SELL of 1172, and the BUY was cancelled 494ms after that. The market-making explanation covers the quotes but not this order, which is about 9x the desk's typical size and was one-sided. Feature (a), an order not intended to execute, is plausible. Feature (b) is not shown: price_move is 0, reversion is 0, and the sell filled at 10000 and 9999. The evidence is mixed, so I am escalating rather than closing.

Registered market maker on SYN.A re-quoting a SELL 3724 / BUY 744 pair every ~3s, with both sides cancelled and re-placed together. The SELL side executed repeatedly (11872 filled). There was no BUY execution in the window, so there was no opposite-side benefit. No single order reached 3x depth. Market making is supported, and both core features are absent.

Detector fired on the registered market maker's repeated two-sided 2174-lot quote refreshes, plus one large SELL O-00039014 (15995, 7.03x depth). The quotes are ordinary market making. The large order was working: 4484 (28%) executed on it before the trader's only opposite-side trade (BUY 362 at 16:48:34.758), which is far above the one-tenth rule. The large order showed no reversion, so I found no feature (b). Remainder 11511 cancelled. Closing as genuine execution of the resting order, with market making accounting for the quotes.

Detector fired on the trader's two-sided 4059-lot quote cycling plus one large BUY, O-00005963 (34241, 13.2x depth). The quotes are registered market making on SYN.A. They are symmetric, typical size, and re-priced every 2-3s. The large order is the real question. It executed 16367 (47.8%) before the trader's only opposite-side trade, a SELL of 676. So it was working, which means feature (a) is absent. The 676 sell is far smaller than the executed quantity and is ordinary order management, so feature (b) is absent. The remainder was cancelled after further fills. No market event, no repetition of a large one-sided order. Proposed CLOSE_FP on the genuine-execution explanation for the large order; the market-making explanation covers only the quotes.

Registered SYN.A market maker (T-X0923-02) quoted two-sided at 3681 for about 40s, then placed a single one-sided BUY of 32660 (12.6x depth) at 9999, 3 ticks from the touch, with no resting SELL. 1.9s later it sold 1534 by market order, with price moving 2 ticks in its favour. It cancelled the whole BUY 327ms after that, and the price reverted 2.5 ticks. The BUY had no fills. The large order is not a quote, so market making does not account for it. Both core features are present, so I propose ESCALATE to Level 2. I did not propose DRAFT_STOR because the cycle occurred once and the trader has no prior alerts.

Registered ETF-MM market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at its typical size of 2725 (about 1.05x depth), re-quoting every 2-3 s with paired cancels (cancel_symmetry 0.95). Quotes were executed (10929 same-side fill, about 10% of submitted size). No single large order, no one-sided resting order, no favourable move (0.5 tick), round trip -0.10 ticks. The detector fired on gross quote churn. Features (a) and (b) are absent and market making is supported.

Registered market maker on SYN.A re-quoting a SELL (3142) and a BUY (628) every ~3s, cancelling and replacing both together as the touch drifted down from 10000 to ~9994. No single order reached 3x depth (max 1.21x). The SELL orders were executing: 4517 filled before the first opposite-side trade, 9968 in total. The two opposite-side BUY fills were small (15 and 142) with price_move 0.5 tick and reversion 0.0, so there is no benefit. Core features (a) and (b) are both absent and market making plus genuine execution are supported.

Registered MM T-X0924-01 quoted SYN.A two-sided at typical size (3524) for about 100s, which is ordinary market making, and that part explains most of the detector's trigger. The tape then shows a different order. At 10:57:01.686, after the quoting stopped, it placed a one-sided SELL of 29079 at 10000 (12.85x depth, 3 ticks from the touch, nothing resting on the bid). 1.76s later it sent a MARKET BUY of 1468 that swept the ask from 9996 to 9998, and 418ms after that it cancelled the whole SELL with no fill. The order was not a quote, had no fills before the opposite trade, and was withdrawn right after the opposite-side trade. The price moved 0.5 ticks and reverted 1.0 tick. The benefit is small and the evidence is mixed, so no explanation is supported and I propose escalation to Level 2. This is not a STOR draft proposal because the cycle happened once and the benefit is marginal.

Registered SYN.A market maker quoted both sides at typical size (2676) with symmetric cancels, then placed one BUY of 20635 (9.1x depth) at the touch. That order executed 5483 (26.6%) BEFORE the trader's only opposite-side trade (SELL 446) and 465 after. The price did not move and did not revert. The remainder (14687) was cancelled. The order was working, so feature (a) is absent. The small SELL gave no benefit, so feature (b) is absent. Closing as genuine execution of the resting order.

Registered ETF-MM market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides with a SELL of 3849 (its typical order size) and a BUY of 769, and re-quoting both together about every 3s. The only executions were on its own SELL quotes (11549 total). There was no opposite-side (BUY) execution, so there was no benefit. No single order reached 3x depth (max 1.70x). The detector's 'SELL execution' is a fill on the trader's own resting quote, not an opposite-side trade. Both core features are absent and market making is supported.

Registered market maker on SYN.A quoting both sides at its typical size (2652) and re-pricing both sides together about every 2-3s. Cancels are symmetric (0.995). No order reached 3x depth (max 1.17x). Executions were on its own quotes. Price moved against the opposite-side trades (-1 tick) with no reversion. No public event and no prior alerts. The detector fired on gross quote churn, not spoofing.

Registered SYN.A market maker quoted 3564 on both sides, then placed one large one-sided BUY O-00006460 (28848, 11.0x depth, 1 tick behind the touch). That order executed 10495 (36%) BEFORE the trader's only opposite-side trade on it (SELL 594 at 10:20:49.990), so it was a working order (feature a absent). The later 594 SELL, smaller than the prior fills, and the cancel of the 18353 remainder are ordinary order management, not a benefit (feature b absent) under section 6.2. The two-sided quoting does not explain the large order. The genuine-execution test does. Residual doubt: the large order is atypical in size and one-sided, with +1 tick move and 1 tick reversion.

Registered market maker on SYN.A re-quoting a SELL 4219 / BUY 843 pair about every 3s, with the quotes following the falling touch. The SELL quotes were genuinely executing: 8867 filled on the SELL side, 3478 of it before any opposite-side trade, against only 265 bought. No single order reached 3x depth (max 1.6x). The price fell 6.5 ticks, but SELL fills were large so that figure is uninformative. Reversion is 0, so there is no price benefit. Feature (a) and feature (b) are both absent. The sizes are skewed to the sell side, which is worth a reviewer's glance.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting a bid and an ask of the same desk-typical size (2964) each cycle. Each pair is cancelled together and re-quoted one tick-width around the moving touch. No order reaches 3x depth. Cancels are symmetric (0.97). Round trip is slightly negative. The only opposite-side fills are small quote fills, with no one-sided resting order that moved the price. The alert fired because the detector counts two-sided quote churn as gross one-sided size.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quotes two-sided at its typical 3741 size, and that part looks like ordinary market making. The alert is driven by one different order: a one-sided SELL of 26426 (10.08x depth) at 10003, 2 ticks from the touch. It was placed at 15:17:46.705 with nothing resting on the BUY side. It had no fills. The trader sent a 1559 MARKET BUY at 15:17:48.437 and cancelled the SELL 194 ms later. Feature (a) is present on that order and no accepted explanation covers it. Feature (b) is not shown: price move 0 and reversion 0 on the order, and the buy walked the book up to 10003, so it was filled at worse prices. The evidence is mixed, so this goes to Level 2. It is not a STOR draft, because there is no demonstrated benefit and no repetition.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) re-quoting a SELL 3237 / BUY 647 pair every ~3s as the touch drifted down from 10004 to 9998 ticks. Both sides are pulled and replaced together each cycle. The SELL quotes executed heavily (9341 filled). The single 536 BUY fill came with no favourable move (+0.5 tick) and no reversion (0.0), and the round trip is negative (-1.34 ticks). No single order reached 3x depth (max 1.34x). Closing as market making. The sell/buy size skew and cancel_symmetry of 0.35 are the weak point for Level 2 to check.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting both sides at its typical size 2876, re-quoting every ~2s in pairs. Cancels are symmetric (0.975). The max resting order is 1.19x depth and large_orders is empty. Price moved -0.5 ticks (against the trader) and did not revert. The opposite-side fills are executions on its own resting quotes. Neither core feature is present; closing as market making.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM). The detector fired on the trader's two-sided 2872-lot quotes: the BUY quote was filled for 2872 at 14:58:57 while the paired SELL quote was cancelled. The quotes are symmetric re-quotes. One order in the window, SELL O-00029447 (23633, 9.77x depth), is large and is the one that matters. It was working: 6795 (28.75%) executed before the trader's only opposite-side trade, a BUY of 478 at 14:59:49.5. The remainder was cancelled 3.07s after that trade. The opposite trade is small, and the price did not revert. Feature (a) is absent, and feature (b) is not shown.

Registered MM T-X0928-04 quoted SYN.A two-sided at its typical 2734 size for ~45s. The detector's three triggers are all on those quotes, and they look like market making. At 15:44:59.282, though, it placed a one-sided BUY of 18989 (7.85x depth) at 9995, 2 ticks from the touch, with nothing resting on the other side. It then sold 1139 at market at 15:45:02.090 and cancelled the BUY 156 ms later. The BUY had no fills. Market making does not account for this order. Feature (a) looks present, and feature (b) is arguable. Escalate to Level 2. Repetition is only 1, so no STOR draft is proposed at Level 1.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM desk) quoting a SELL of 3642 and a BUY of 728 at the touch, cancelled and re-quoted together every ~3s. The detector's 'SELL execution' triggers are fills on the trader's own SELL quotes. There was no opposite-side (BUY) execution at all, so no benefit. No single order reached 3x depth. Market making is supported. Both core features are absent.

Registered MM on SYN.A quoted two-sided at 2704 for about 45s, and that quoting is routine. At 11:36:12.079 it then placed a single SELL of 19639 (7.9x depth) at 10006, 3 ticks from the touch, with nothing resting on the BUY side. Two seconds later it sent a BUY MARKET of 1127 that filled at 10004-10005. The large SELL was cancelled 444 ms after that, with zero executions. Market making does not account for this order: its size is about 7x the desk's typical 2704, and it is one-sided and has no fills. Feature (a) is present, and feature (b) is plausibly present (+0.5 tick move, 2.0 ticks reversion). Escalate to Level 2. This is a single cycle, so I am not proposing a STOR draft.

Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting symmetric two-sided 2604-lot bid/ask pairs and re-pricing them every 1-3 s. The detector's 'cancelled within 5s' trigger matches ordinary quote refreshes. No single order reaches 3x depth. Its resting BUY orders executed (3040 before any opposite-side trade), the price moved against the trader (-1.5 ticks), and the round trip is about 0.11 ticks. Neither core feature is present.

The detector fired on a registered market maker's BUY activity on SYN.A. The window has two parts. The first is a two-sided 2967-lot quote cycle with symmetric cancels (cancel_symmetry 0.86), which is market making. The second is one large BUY, O-00038018, at 21721 lots (8.78x depth). It was a working order. 9975 lots (45.9%) executed on it before the trader's only opposite-side trade on that order (SELL 494 at 16:38:04.829). That sell was small next to the executed quantity. The order's price move was +0.5 tick with zero reversion. The remainder (11746) was cancelled 2.26s after the sell. Feature (a) is absent because the order was genuinely executing. Feature (b) is absent because there was no benefit from the opposite trade. Closing as genuine execution of the resting order. Level 2 may want to look at the size of the order relative to the desk's typical order.
